title: ever ALIX|Short Sleeves Sequin High Low V-Neck Midi Mother of the Bride Dress
descriptionHtml:
This stylish mother of the bride dress features short sleeves and a flattering high-low hemline for a modern yet elegant look. The V-neck adds sophistication, while sequin detailing ensures you sparkle throughout the day. Perfect for any formal event, this midi dress offers a beautiful blend of comfort and glamour.


Fit: Please refer to Size Chart.


Length: High Low.


Sleeve Style: Short Sleeves.


Closure: It is Concealed a Zipper Up The Back.


Undergarments: It is Not Padded, with Lining.


Fabric:Sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is Low Stretch.


Occasion: Formal, Evening Party, Special Occasion
